replay_budget.reason: The frozen cases and oracle outcomes have now been observed. Reusing them cannot provide fresh acceptance evidence even if a more faithful surface becomes available.

execution_surface.source_transport: Official Debian bytes were fetched on a connected networked computation surface, losslessly encoded into image pixels, imported by Google Slides, exported into the ChatGPT container, reconstructed, and hash-verified before use.

gate_arithmetic_note: The spec threshold 0.6666666667 is slightly above exact 2/3. The observed 0.6666666666666666 plus the runner's 1e-12 tolerance remains below that decimal threshold; therefore family recall also fails the literal gate, independently of top20 recall.

admissibility_reconciliation.intended_surface_requirement: Exact PR85 bytes on reliable Debian/Ubuntu-like Linux with live apt-file Contents indices, hard $0 incremental spend, <=600 seconds.
satisfied: fresh official Debian Contents bytes with end-to-end hash verification
no package hints or task-specific literals
unsatisfied_or_materially_degraded: normal APT Packages metadata was absent, so apt-cache search contributed no package-description candidates
runtime outbound network was unavailable, so bounded Ubuntu-manpage semantic enrichment could not execute
admissibility_reconciliation.implication: The result proves the batched apt-file acquisition path runs quickly on genuine Contents data and exposes poor ranks under degraded metadata/enrichment. It does not isolate whether the intended full PR85 algorithm would pass on a normal connected Debian/Ubuntu APT surface.

preserved_gain: The prior wall-clock blocker was materially reduced: the exact three-case runner completed in 96.824453 seconds rather than timing out.
Genuine batched apt-file executable evidence reached two of three oracle families without package hints.
The transfer/execution blocker is no longer the only frontier; environment fidelity and semantic ranking attribution are now measurable.
